items.quote: shortened to the Pueblo de los Ángeles ("town of the angels"), was the Spanish civilian pueblo
items.note: The city article gives the literal translation only inside a {{lit|The Angels}} template, which the checker strips, so the Pueblo article is cited. A pedant may offer the full founding name (Our Lady the Queen of the Angels), but the question says 'Los Angeles', so 'The Angels' is the one answer.

items.quote: The contract stipulated that "LAND" be removed to spell "Hollywood"
items.note: Also: 'originally erected in 1923 ... spelled out HOLLYWOODLAND'. Easy for anyone who knows the Hollywoodland story, but not ambiguous.

items.quote: For the 1958 season, the Dodgers moved to Los Angeles and kept their nickname
items.note: Same article: 'After 68 seasons in Brooklyn, Dodgers owner and president Walter O'Malley moved the franchise to Los Angeles before the 1958 season.'

items.quote: Among the prehistoric Pleistocene species associated with the La Brea Tar Pits are Columbian mammoths, dire wolves
items.note: Same article: 'Hancock Park was established around a cluster of tar pits' and the saber-toothed cat (Smilodon fatalis) is the state fossil found there. Excavation is ongoing.

items.quote: the Coliseum became the first stadium to host the Summer Olympic Games twice
items.note: Article also: 'previously hosting in 1932 and 1984'. Rose Bowl hosted 1984 football only, not both Games, so no second answer.

items.quote: embedded in the sidewalks along fifteen blocks of Hollywood Boulevard and three blocks of Vine Street
Inspired by Minnesota's nickname, "Land of 10,000 Lakes", the team rechristened themselves the Lakers
items.note: They played in Minneapolis; a room might say 'Minneapolis', but the question asks for the state.

items.quote: The Walt Disney Concert Hall was designed by world-renowned architect Frank Gehry
Nearly 200 Hollywood celebrity handprints, footprints, and autographs are in the concrete of the theater's forecourt
items.note: Host should accept 'handprints', 'footprints' or either with signatures/autographs; the blocks carry all three. TCL naming confirmed current: 'officially branded as the TCL Chinese Theatre for sponsorship reasons'.

items.quote: The University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) is a public land-grant research university in the Westwood neighborhood of Los Angeles
items.note: Also: 'UCLA student-athletes compete as the Bruins'.
